 Eagles Make Four Moves, Place RB Dameon Pierce On IR
 By Nate Bouda - October 28, 2026 
 The Philadelphia Eagles announced a series of roster moves on Wednesday including placing RB Dameon Pierce on injured reserve. 
 The Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue to their active roster and added G Evan Beerntsen , WR Quentin Skinner , and DB Shaun Wade to their practice squad.
 Pierce, 26, was a fourth-round pick by the Texans out of Florida in the 2022 NFL Draft. He was in the final year of his $4,475,432 rookie contract, with an average annual value of $1,118,858, when the Texans opted to waive him.
 He caught on with the Chiefs on the practice squad to finish out the season before joining the Eagles in the offseason. Philadelphia re-signed him to their practice squad coming out of the preseason. 
 In 2026, Piece has appeared in three games for the Eagles and rushed for 96 yards on 37 carries (2.6 YPC) to go along with seven receptions for 14 yards receiving and two touchdowns.
